exclusions.source_text: For patients with NF2/CDKN2A/AKT1/PIK3CA/PTEN mutation, CKDN2A copy number loss, or CDK4/CDK6/CCND1/CCND2/CCND3/CCNE1 copy number gain: Age \>= 18 years
For patients with SMO/PTCH1 mutation: Age \>= 30 years
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status =\< 2
No metastatic meningiomas (as defined by extracranial meningiomas outside of CNS) allowed; spinal meningiomas are allowed
No current Child Pugh class B or C liver disease
exclusions.threshold: Child Pugh class B or C

exclusions.source_text: Experience any of the following procedures or conditions in the preceding 6 months: coronary artery bypass graft, angioplasty, vascular stent, myocardial infarction, angina pectoris, congestive heart failure New York Heart Association (NYHA) class \>= II
No uncontrolled diabetes defined as a known diabetic with HBA1C \> 7.5 OR fasting glucose \> 140 mg/dL.
Creatinine OR =\< 1.5 mg/dl x upper limit of normal (ULN) OR calculated (calc.) creatinine clearance \> 50 mL/min
exclusions.threshold: creatinine <= 1.5 x ULN or CrCl > 50 mL/min

exclusions.source_text: Total bilirubin =\< 1.5 x upper limit of normal (ULN); except in case of Gilbert's disease
QTcF \< 450 msec (QT calculated using Fridericia formula)
such as known human immunodeficiency virus positivity
